label: enemies
description: Vine Hound plant-beast enemy, 3 actions x 5 frames (run/attack/death)
original_prompt:
Hand-painted circus-style sprite sheet of "Vine Hound", a sinister plant-hybrid beast enemy for a side-scrolling game. It is a four-legged canine/hound body made of twisted dark olive-green and brown vine-stem flesh — gnarled woody legs with clawed paws, a long sinuous tail ending in a small red flower bud, thorny tendrils and leafy growths sprouting along its spine and flanks. Its head is a pale bone-white skull-like hound face with glowing yellow eyes and a wide open maw full of sharp fangs; erupting from its neck/shoulders is a large blooming deep-red flower (a peony/poppy-like bloom) whose petals fan out like a mane or ruff collar, each petal glossy crimson with darker shading and tiny highlights. Art style: painterly hand-drawn animation, bold clean outlines, warm saturated colors (deep crimson reds, olive/brown greens, bone white, gold-yellow eye glow), dynamic poses, subtle motion smears on fast moves.

Sheet layout: 3 rows x 5 columns on a solid pink background with a faint light grid dividing the cells, plus a narrow left-hand label column (rotated text naming each row's action). Each row is one action, left to right:

Row 1 — Run cycle (5 frames): a low, striding sprint across the frame, legs pumping wide, tail streaming behind, the red flower mane swaying, body leaning forward — contact -> down -> passing -> up -> contact.

Row 2 — Attack (5 frames): the hound rears/lunges to strike — crouched wind-up -> rising into an aggressive lunge with jaws wide open -> full extended lunge where the body stretches out into a long thorn-vine whip ending in a huge open-mouthed carnivorous flower head (snapping venus-flytrap-like bloom with ringed teeth) flung out to the right, shedding loose red petals/debris -> recovery back to a ready stance.

Row 3 — Death (5 frames): the hound collapses and dissolves apart — frame 1 intact but staggering, then progressively breaking down into a heap of vines, stems, and a spray of loose red petals that scatter outward and fade until only a tangle of greenery and drifting petals remain by the final frame.

Character faces right, consistent proportions and palette across all 15 frames.
